organization.short_description:
Adobe Inc. is a prominent American multinational software company based in San Jose, California. Founded in December 1982, Adobe specializes in software tools for digital media creation, document management, and digital marketing. The company rebranded from Adobe Systems Incorporated to Adobe Inc. in October 2018 and is publicly traded on NASDAQ under the symbol ADBE.

Adobe offers a wide range of products organized into three main business clouds: Creative Cloud, Document Cloud, and Experience Cloud. Key products include Adobe Photoshop for image editing, Adobe Illustrator for vector illustration, Adobe Acrobat for document management, and Adobe Premiere Pro for video editing. The company also incorporates AI-powered features in tools like Adobe Firefly and Acrobat AI Assistant. Adobe serves a diverse customer base, including creative professionals, marketers, and businesses of all sizes, enabling them to create and manage content across various platforms. With a reported revenue of approximately $19.41 billion in fiscal 2023, Adobe employs over 30,000 people globally.
